card.name: Digits in section cross-references and Ph+ before ALL
card.fires_on: The digit or sign just before a following number or the word ALL: the first digit of a section number in parentheses like (5.1), a digit inside a number, or the plus in Ph+ before ALL.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: A digit in a parenthesized warnings or adverse-reaction section reference, right before the decimal point or closing bracket.
modes.example: History of serious pancreatitis during previous asparaginase therapy [see Warnings and Precautions ( <<5>>.2 )]

modes.label: Ph+ before ALL
modes.description: The plus sign after Ph in Philadelphia-chromosome-positive leukemia, just before ALL.
modes.example: treatment with dasatinib in pediatric patients with Ph<<+>> ALL was administered

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A digit partway through a number such as a decimal value or a count of days.
modes.example: Remove the SINUVA Sinus Implant by <<9>>0 days or earlier

card.writes: It pushes the word ALL (and 'all' in other languages) as the next word and suppresses words like 'anything'.
card.plain: It fires on a number's leading digit in section references, and on the plus in Ph+, where the word ALL comes next.
